summary: IREN Ltd (IREN) filed an 8-K disclosing the pricing of $2.6 billion aggregate principal amount of 1.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2033, with an underwriter option for an additional $400 million. The notes are being sold to QIBs under Rule 144A. The offering is expected to close May 14, 2026. Net proceeds are estimated at ~$2.57B (~$2.96B if full exercise of option), with ~$174.5M used for capped call transactions and the remainder for general corporate purposes and working capital. The notes are unregistered and rely on exemption from registration. Capped calls reduce dilution from conversion. Watch for conversion premium and stock overhang post-offering; risk-arb focuses on note pricing and potential share dilution if conversion occurs.
